description: Image Description: A lioness is shown in profile, facing to the right, with a blue plastic bottle clutched in her mouth. The lioness has a golden-brown coat, with visible tufts of fur and prominent whiskers. Her ears are upright, and her eyes appear focused ahead. The plastic bottle is crumpled and partially chewed, indicating it may have been picked up from the environment. The background consists of tall grasses and greenery, suggesting a natural savanna
